sites.name: Black Carrs

named.place: St Abb's Head coast, St Abbs and Eyemouth voluntary marine reserve

sites.note: Map reading from the reserve's own leaflet (BMR Leaflet.pdf, page 1 map, north-up with a 1 km scale bar), rendered at 5x (4209x2977 px). The pixel-to-lat/lon fit was made by matching the leaflet's drawn coastline from Pettico Wick to Weasel Loch to the OSM natural=coastline ways (about 4.1 m per px east-west, 4.2 m per px north-south, median misfit 17 m; the scale bar gives 4.2 m per px). Landmark check with that fit: OSM Pettico Wick Harbour (55.91513,-2.15002), Horsecastle Bay (55.91020,-2.13117), Starney Bay (55.90266,-2.13453) and Weasel Loch (55.87834,-2.09835) each land within 30 px of the coast-side end of the leaflet's label for that place. The leaflet names places with text labels, not markers; the point taken is the coast-side end of the label, at mid text height. Black Carrs label left end at px (1941,506); OSM Little Black Carrs rock (55.90838,-2.12779) is about 80 m away, in the water north east of the St Abbs harbour bay. Tyneside BSAC (club log), Marine Quest (Eyemouth charter) and X-Ray Mag are unrelated publishers. Glanmire (UKHO, 55.92028,-2.13760) is over 1 km away.

sites.name: Blue Caps

named.place: Blue Caps reef, west of the Longstone, Farne Islands outer group

sites.note: Placed by the JNCC 1987-88 MNCR survey station 'SE Bluecaps' (grid-reference precision). REVIEW: the point is 156 m from the Chris Christenson register record, just outside the 150 m overlap; the register point itself sits about 340 m west of Divernet's stated position for that wreck, so the two sites may look closer than they are. Named by a Tyneside 114 log and an Ipswich Dive Club trip report.

sites.note: Placed by the JNCC 1987-88 MNCR survey station 'NE (inner) of Crumstone' (grid-reference precision), about 430 m north-east of the Crumstone islet in OSM. This record names the reef dive, not the Skovdal or Britannia wrecks (Skovdal record about 530 m away).

The Tyneside 114 log and the Freedivers UK trip both dive the north side of the Harcars for seals; the Divernet feature dives the north-west side of Big Harcar.

Divernet's own stated figure for the Knivestone (54 39.00 N 001 36.00 W) is a whole-minute figure with a wrong degree (54 for 55) and is left out. About 300 m from the Jan Van Ryswyck register record at Whirl Rocks.

sites.name: Barracuda Point

named.place: Sipadan Island reef

sites.note: Map-read from Scuba Junkie's Sipadan Island dive map (556x417 px, north up, dive-flag markers; flag centre taken). Fit from the OpenStreetMap coastline of Pulau Sipadan (way 96698692): latitude from its north tip 4.11757,118.62823 at map y=164 and south tip 4.11202,118.62987 at y=226.5 (about 9.8 m per px); longitude from its west point 4.11544,118.62716 at x=235 and east point 4.11254,118.63069 at x=288 (about 7.4 m per px). The drawn reef outline, extended with this fit, lands within about 150 m of the reef edge on satellite imagery, so expect errors of 100 to 300 m; the island is about 600 m long, so check neighbours. Flag sits just west of the reef's north tip. Named by two independent operators: Scuba Junkie (Mabul) and Seaventures (dive rig off Mabul). Permit: Scuba Junkie's Sipadan page says Sabah Parks permits are needed to dive Sipadan.
